map.填写「先放水再放粉」。: Fill in 'add water first then powder'.
map.日常瓶喂冲调：已知目标喂奶量（如 180ml）与罐体标注比例（多为 30ml/勺: Daily bottle feeding: given target milk volume (e.g. 180ml) and label ratio (mostly 30ml/scoop), quickly compute how many level scoops of powder and water amount.
map.不同品牌切换：各品牌勺量不同（常见 30ml/勺，部分 60ml/勺），按比例换: Switching brands: scoop sizes differ by brand (commonly 30ml/scoop, some 60ml/scoop); scale proportionally to avoid too concentrated (kidney burden) or too dilute (insufficient nutrition).
map.外出便携：用「目标量÷比例」反推需带几勺粉，配合保温瓶分装温水，到店现冲保证卫生: Portable on the go: use 'target amount / ratio' to back-calculate how many scoops to bring, with a thermos of warm water, prepare on site for hygiene.
map.：勺数 = round(180/30) = 6 勺；水量 = 6×30 = 18: : scoops = round(180/30) = 6 scoops; water = 6*30 = 180ml (add warm water first); after reconstitution total volume ~ 180 + round(6*4.3) = 180 + 26 = 206ml (each scoop powder ~4.3g, volume slightly increases after dissolving). That is 6 level scoops of powder + 180ml warm water.
map.务必先加水到刻度再平勺加粉，可避免总体积超标导致过浓。每勺必须刮平（不用堆尖），: Always add water to the mark first, then add powder with a level scoop; this avoids total volume exceeding the limit and becoming too concentrated. Each scoop must be leveled (not heaped) so concentration matches the label.
map.多数配方奶建议 40–50°C 温水（部分品牌 40°C），既能溶解又保留活性营: Most formula milk recommends 40-50 deg C warm water (some brands 40 deg C), dissolving while preserving active nutrients; never use boiling water, which destroys probiotics and protein structure. Feed immediately after reconstitution or refrigerate; do not reheat leftover milk repeatedly.
